name: Twilight Hour
source:
Twilight Hour is a multichaptered death game visual novel with adventure elements. 

The story follows Futada Risa as she and eight other students participate in a death game show, which is being broadcasted for public entertainment.

[From [url=https://knifely.itch.io/twilight-hour]itch.io[/url]]
